Bust of Auguste Rodin
(Claudel)
The
Bust of Auguste Rodin
was sculpted by the French artist
Camille Claudel
in 1888-1889 as a tribute to her teacher and lover,
Auguste Rodin
.
[
1
]
Casts
A bronze cast of the work was displayed in the 1892
Salon de la Société Nationale des Beaux–Arts
on the
Champ de Mars
to critical acclaim.
